episodes.title: Spear and Fang
episodes.summary: Tragedy forces a caveman and a dinosaur to rely upon each other for their survival.

episodes.title: River of Snakes
episodes.summary: Man and beast are challenged to find a way to exist together.

episodes.title: A Cold Death
episodes.summary: In the harshness of the primordial winter a herd of woolly mammoths hunt for the murderers of one of their own.

episodes.title: Terror Under the Blood Moon
episodes.summary: The horrors of the red night challenges Spear and Fang for their very survival.

episodes.title: Rage of the Ape-Men
episodes.summary: An oasis of peace only leads to a brutal attack from a vicious tribe of ape-like men.

episodes.title: Plague of Madness
episodes.summary: Spear and Fang take on an infection with zombified dinosaurs.

episodes.title: Scent of Prey
episodes.summary: Spear struggles to nurse Fang back to health and escape the scavengers of the primordial world.

episodes.title: Coven of the Damned
episodes.summary: A tribe of mysterious, primitive women seek to further their coven by using dark magic on Spear and Fang.

episodes.title: The Night Feeder
episodes.summary: A horrific unseen terror stalks the night as well as our heroes, Spear and Fang.

episodes.title: Slave of the Scorpion
episodes.summary: Spear and Fang are confronted by a far more developed human than they've ever encountered before.

episodes.title: Sea of Despair
episodes.summary: Spear and Fang venture into the unknown to rescue Mira from her captors.

episodes.title: Shadow of Fate
episodes.summary: Spear and Fang get separated in a strange new land.

episodes.title: Dawn of Man
episodes.summary: The quest to find Mira leads Spear and Fang to the village of fearsome warriors.

episodes.title: The Red Mist
episodes.summary: Spear and Fang fight to save Mira from the warrior clan that enslaved her.

episodes.title: The Primal Theory
episodes.summary: A night of horrors reveals the true nature of man's origin.

episodes.title: Vidarr
episodes.summary: Spear, Fang, and Mira are hunted by the last survivors of a village decimated by their carnage.

episodes.title: The Colossaeus Part I
episodes.summary: Spear, Fang, and Mira's journey home is threatened after encountering a mysterious threat at sea.

episodes.title: The Colossaeus, Part II
episodes.summary: Spear and Fang are used as instruments of war for the tyrannical queen of a formidable warship, the Colossaeus.

episodes.title: The Colossaeus, Part III
episodes.summary: Spear, Fang and Mira lead a daring escape from the Colossaeus and the Queen bent on their destruction.

episodes.title: Echoes of Eternity
episodes.summary: An old vengeance returns to wreak havoc.

episodes.title: Vengeance of Death
episodes.summary: Spear's lifeless body is reanimated to enact brutal vengeance.

episodes.title: Kingdom of Sorrow
episodes.summary: A zombified Spear wanders aimlessly with no purpose until a distant sound awakens something deep inside and calls to him like a beacon from the past.

episodes.title: Feast of Flesh
episodes.summary: Spear is drawn to follow a very familiar creature, which leads him to make a horrific discovery.

episodes.title: Prey for the Wicked
episodes.summary: A pack of hideous creatures attack a village, forcing the villagers to flee.

episodes.title: The Dead Cast No Shadow
episodes.summary: The ramifications of Spear's return from the dead reverberate through the world he once knew.

episodes.title: Cavern of Horrors
episodes.summary: A rescue party makes a terrifying discovery while attempting to save villagers from a pack of hideous hyena-like creatures.

episodes.title: Heart of the Undead
episodes.summary: Spear's world shatters when he's shunned by everyone and finally realizes what he has become.

episodes.title: The River of Life
episodes.summary: Spear finds a new path after encountering a primordial tribe that time forgot.

episodes.title: The Hollow Crown
episodes.summary: Spear starts to question his new life with the Black River people.

episodes.title: An Echo of Eternity
episodes.summary: Spear is caught in an epic battle to appease the bloodlust of the Black River People.
